question: On a population REGISTERED BY THE SAME LIVE CRAWL that supplies both the cold baseline and the persisted store (the parent packet's frozen aged item list is used only as an overlap covariate, never as the denominator), does maintaining a persisted deep state-carrying path store cost less Web work than cold re-derivation, and does it pay per item as well as in aggregate? Concretely: with the cold comparator measured live as one frozen-policy cold crawl of the four bound min-hop seed hosts (M-COLD-BATCH-GETS = actual GETs spent; per-item share M-COLD-BATCH-GETS / n_admitted), and the treatment measured live as the store's true maintenance cost (one GET per DISTINCT stored page per cycle, M-REVAL-UNIQUE-GETS = |union of item paths|, which is also the physical spend) against the pessimistic no-sharing accounting (M-REVAL-NOSHARE-GETS = sum of per-item path lengths), the frozen 10% material-margin rule decides (A) the fully-loaded per-item comparison mean path <= 0.9 * cold/n_admitted and (B) the memoryful batch comparison |union| <= 0.9 * cold; and, at session-scale horizons only, what is the measured invalidation hazard of the stored pages (changed/dead/moved), the per-item false-accept rate of 0-GET naive exact-path replay with its 95% upper bound, and the cost-optimal revalidation interval tau implied by that bound - such that the store-vs-cold build decision, the cross-item page-sharing factor that makes the store pay, the endpoint-only fallback's sufficiency, and the 'is any revalidation needed inside a session at all' product decision are each settled by measurement rather than by assumption?
hypothesis: H1 (store aggregate economics, B): cross-item page sharing on this frame is large, so the store's per-cycle maintenance cost |union of paths| is far below 0.9 * M-COLD-BATCH-GETS, i.e. the strongest fair memoryful alternative (re-derive everything by a cold host sweep) loses against maintaining the store. H2 (per-item economics, A): the SAME mechanism does NOT pay for an isolated item: mean path length is comparable to the amortized cold per-item share because the cold crawl is dominated by the deep stratum on this frame, so A is expected to fail while B succeeds; the decision-relevant quantity is the measured sharing factor M-STORE-SHARING-FACTOR = sum|path| / |union| and the reuse density M-REUSE-ITEMS-PER-PAGE that determines the minimum multi-item workload at which the store pays. H3 (invalidation, the genuinely unknown axis): at session-scale horizons the stored documentation pages are expected to be nearly or exactly invariant, so M-CHANGE-RATE / M-DEAD-RATE / M-FALSE-ACCEPT-NAIVE are expected to be 0 or near 0; the informative output is therefore not the point estimate but the censoring-aware bound M-HAZARD-RATE-UB95 (exact Poisson upper bound on the per-page-second incidence rate; rule of three at zero events), the derived M-FALSE-ACCEPT-UB95, and the tolerance ladder M-TAU-LADDER that says which product staleness tolerance is and is not certifiable inside one session. H4 (fallback sufficiency): because interior (non-endpoint) stored pages are few relative to endpoints, endpoint-only revalidation (1 GET/item/cycle, read exactly from the same cycle rows at zero extra GET cost) should detect essentially every invalidation the full path detects; M-INTERIOR-ONLY-FAILS measures the residual it would miss.
falsifier: The persistence claim is falsified for this frame when the aggregate store comparison fails at every measured cycle (M-REVAL-UNIQUE-GETS > 0.9 * M-COLD-BATCH-GETS, i.e. cross-item sharing buys nothing) AND the per-item comparison fails at every measured cycle (mean path > 0.9 * cold/n_admitted), with measurement valid. It is supported when both comparisons pay at every measured cycle. Any other combination is MIXED, and because |union| <= sum|path| = n_admitted * mean_path, a per-item pay implies an aggregate pay, so the only MIXED sub-state this experiment can produce is 'pays in aggregate through cross-item page sharing but not for an isolated item'. Censorship, control failure, census-gate failure, budget exhaustion, envelope exhaustion before one complete cycle, or a failed live change-detector sensitivity control are NOT falsification: they are INCONCLUSIVE or MEASUREMENT_INVALID with the exact cause, and they are pre-registered dispositions. Independently of the 3-way label, the packet falsifies the stronger form of H1 if the measured sharing factor is <= 1.0 (no cross-item sharing), and falsifies H3 as a bound-based claim if the observed invalidation rate is high enough that no product tolerance in M-TAU-LADDER is certifiable inside a session.

baselines.definition: One cold frozen-policy crawl per bound host per cycle that re-derives everything: same-host static <a> links, item-blind FIFO, per-seed budget 250, depth 6, each URL fetched at most once, anchor = netloc of the seed's FINAL url after redirects (policy identical to the bound parent by verbatim reuse of its transport helpers). Cost = M-COLD-BATCH-GETS = the ACTUAL number of GETs the crawl spent, recorded by the module's ledger. Frozen-frame reference from EXP-FRONTIER-38164611798 was 250+250+176+250 = 926 discovered URLs. The aggregate comparison pays iff M-REVAL-UNIQUE-GETS <= 0.9 * M-COLD-BATCH-GETS.

Fully-loaded per-item cold cost of maintaining the whole admitted set by that cold crawl: M-COLD-BATCH-GETS / n_admitted, where n_admitted is the population registered by the SAME crawl (so numerator and denominator are one measurement). The per-item comparison pays iff mean path length <= 0.9 * (M-COLD-BATCH-GETS / n_admitted). Identity preserved from the parent packet, but re-derived from live values instead of the aged 926/208 = 4.451923 / 4.006731 constants, which the mandate explicitly authorizes replacing once a fresh admitted set is registered.

Per admitted item, its 1-based BFS discovery/fetch ordinal in the live census (M-COLD-ITEM-ORDINAL). Parent reference: mean 166.0144, min 31, max 250 over 208 items. Reported as a descriptive endpoint only and excluded from the decision partition because on this frame it is satisfied by construction and therefore has no dynamic range (identical disposition to the parent packet).

Serve the persisted path with NO revalidation at all: 0 GETs per use, the cost floor. It wins on cost by construction, so it is never treated as an assumed loss; instead its safety is measured: M-FALSE-ACCEPT-NAIVE (share of admitted items with at least one stored page that changed, died or moved since the census) and the bound M-FALSE-ACCEPT-UB95, with the tolerance ladder M-TAU-LADDER stating which product staleness tolerances are certifiable without any revalidation. This is the baseline that decides whether a revalidation mechanism is needed at all.

Targeted cold re-derivation when the agent is handed the item's parent page: 1 GET per item, i.e. n_admitted GETs for the whole set. This is the cheapest possible cold alternative and bounds when the store can pay at all: against it the store never pays per item on this frame. Reported, never a decision branch, and used only to bound the mechanism's generality so the SUPPORTS/MIXED label cannot be read as 'persistence always wins'.

Revalidate only the item endpoints (1 GET/item/cycle = n_admitted GETs). Because every admitted endpoint is already in the store's union page set, this arm is read EXACTLY from the same cycle rows at zero extra GET cost: its cost is n_admitted GETs and its detection set is the endpoint-restricted verdicts. M-INTERIOR-ONLY-FAILS counts invalidations that full-path revalidation would catch and endpoint-only would miss, i.e. the fallback's residual risk. This is the mandate's named fallback mechanism, executed rather than asserted.

The same aggregate comparison evaluated with a store that performs NO cross-item page sharing, i.e. cost = M-REVAL-NOSHARE-GETS = sum over items of path length (the physical spend of the parent packet's frozen module, which refetched each item's full path while REPORTING |union|). Reported as the S-NOSHARE sensitivity verdict alongside the primary dedup-aware verdict, because the parent packet's decision threshold (833.4) lies between these two accountings and the parent never reconciled them.

positive_control: Fifteen offline in-process-fixture controls run by the SAME frozen module code that scores the experiment (bfs_census, path_to, classify, reval, wilson_upper, poisson_ub, decide): C-BFS-PARENT-CHAIN (parent-tracking BFS reconstructs the frozen-FIFO chain), C-STORE-DEDUP-ACCOUNTING (distinct union < no-sharing sum, so the two accountings are separated), C-PATH-CANARY (every store page returns 200), C-REVAL-CHANGE-DETECT (a mutated endpoint is detected while its sibling is not), C-LIVENESS-404 (a removed endpoint is detected dead), C-REVAL-MOVED-REDIRECT (a 302 to a new final URL is classified MOVED, not silently followed), C-HAZARD-BOUND-RULE3 (Poisson bound = 3/N at zero events and strictly above it for 5 events), C-WILSON-BOUND-DIRECTION (Wilson bound strictly increasing in events), C-TAU-LADDER-MONOTONE (tau strictly increasing in tolerance), C-DECISION-CANARY-SUPPORTS / -MIXED / -MIXED-FLIP / -FALSIFIES / -NODATA (all five decision-function states, so no decision branch is empty). Plus one live transport-level positive control: C-LIVE-POS-CHANGE, at least one of three pre-registered volatile URLs whose body must change between observations, proving the change detector fires over real HTTP against real servers (the offline fixture cannot establish that). Observed at DESIGN: 15/15 offline controls PASS; the live positive control's three candidates were each observed to change within a 2 s DESIGN preflight. A control failure at EXECUTE is a hard gate (V2) that blocks the census entirely.
null_control: Null direction, same scoring code: C-REVAL-NOCHANGE (an unchanged store yields zero UNEXPECTED verdicts, so the detector does not fire spuriously) and C-REVAL-CHANGE-DETECT (the same instrument DOES fire on one mutated page, i.e. the null is produced by the page state, not by an insensitive instrument). Live null direction: C-LIVE-NULL-CHANGED, two pre-registered stable URLs (example.com, iana.org/domains/reserved) that were observed stable at DESIGN and must remain stable; any change is reported as a spurious-firing alarm rather than hidden. Statistical null direction: C-HAZARD-BOUND-RULE3 and C-WILSON-BOUND-DIRECTION certify that a zero-event observation produces a non-trivial, correctly directed upper bound rather than a vacuous zero. The decision function's null partition is the no-effect case: FALSIFIES fires only when BOTH comparisons fail at every cycle, so an aggregate win cannot be reported as a per-item win and a per-item win cannot be reported as full support.

measurement_validity.name: code_identity_gate
measurement_validity.rule: EXECUTE reconstructs the frozen module from prereg section 10 and sha256 of the stripped block must equal DERIVED_SHA256 = 017c8bbcab9e8751ac5718affcf6563aa36c1cef82e6e23078c4d3d880804a0a. Any mismatch -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID before any stage.

measurement_validity.name: controls_gate
measurement_validity.rule: All fifteen offline fixture controls must PASS before the live census starts. Any FAIL -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID with the failing control id; the module returns non-zero and writes no census.

measurement_validity.name: live_seed_liveness_gate
measurement_validity.rule: Each bound host whose seed returns HTTP 200 contributes; a seed failure excludes that host with its recorded error. Fewer than MIN_HOSTS = 2 live hosts -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID before any revalidation cycle.

measurement_validity.name: census_gate_before_ladder
measurement_validity.rule: The census gate is evaluated BEFORE any revalidation GET: n_admitted >= MIN_ADMITTED = 40, M-COLD-BATCH-GETS > 0, and coverage is definitional (n_paths == n_admitted because the admitted set IS the set of live hop>=3 fetches with a recorded parent chain, so an aged external item list can no longer produce misses). Failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, decision NO_DATA, zero revalidation GETs spent. This is the repaired form of the parent's V3 path-recovery gate, which was structurally unreachable because it demanded that an aged external list be reconstructed live.

measurement_validity.name: budget_gate
measurement_validity.rule: total GETs across the whole module <= TOTAL_GET_CEILING = 3200, enforced by the module's GET ledger. Overflow -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a negative.

measurement_validity.name: denominator_guard
measurement_validity.rule: M-COLD-BATCH-GETS > 0 and n_admitted > 0 before any thresholding; no 0/0 may enter decide().

measurement_validity.name: session_scale_bound
measurement_validity.rule: Every change/dead/moved/false-accept statement and every tau value is bounded to the measured session horizon (module elapsed time, reported). No day-scale hazard, no freshness-detector claim, no extrapolation beyond the session regime is permitted; the legacy program already established that day-scale staleness is undecidable on committed corpora.

measurement_validity.name: envelope_gate
measurement_validity.rule: Module wall clock <= MODULE_WALL_BUDGET_S = 620 s, and each host's crawl <= CENSUS_HOST_BUDGET_S = 100 s with per-host time_truncated reported. This exists because the harness runs the EXECUTE agent under SPIDER_MODEL_MAX_RUNTIME_SECONDS = 1200 s with TERM/KILL to the whole process group plus git reset --hard and git clean on retry: an over-running measurement is destroyed, not recorded. A cycle is started only if the measured per-GET latency implies it finishes inside the remaining budget; fewer than one completed cycle -> INCONCLUSIVE (treatment object unmeasured), never a negative.

measurement_validity.name: decision_determinism
measurement_validity.rule: decide() is applied to the recorded per-cycle rows and its inputs (n_admitted, M-COLD-BATCH-GETS, mean path, |union|, sum|path|) are all written to derived/metrics.json and to raw/cycle_XX.jsonl, so recomputation is exact and offline.

measurement_validity.name: live_change_detector_sensitivity
measurement_validity.rule: At least one of three pre-registered volatile control URLs must change between observations. If none changes, M-LIVE-POS-CHANGE is false and a zero-event hazard observation is labelled VACUOUS-RISK (an uninterpretable null), never reported as 'nothing changes'. If a stable control URL changes, it is reported as a spurious-firing alarm. Neither case is a scientific negative.

measurement_validity.name: survivor_conditioning_disclosure
measurement_validity.rule: M-DEAD-RATE and M-FALSE-ACCEPT-NAIVE are conditional on the page having survived the census; pages that died or were delinked BEFORE the census are not observable by construction. The pre-census death fraction is reported as the covariate M-CENSUS-OVERLAP-PARENT208 (share of the parent's 208 admitted URLs rediscovered by the live crawl) and the parent's 29/208 miss rate is cited as prior evidence that this conditioning is material. No statement about the pre-census hazard may be derived from this packet.

measurement_validity.name: accounting_reconciliation
measurement_validity.rule: The treatment's reported cost, its physical GET spend, and both accountings (dedup |union| and no-sharing sum|path|) are all recorded and reconciled. The primary verdict uses the dedup-aware accounting because the fixed module physically fetches each distinct stored page once per cycle; the no-sharing verdict is reported as a named sensitivity. Reporting one accounting while spending the other is a hard gate failure (this is the specific defect in the parent packet's frozen module).

decision_rule: Evaluated in order, entirely by the frozen decide() in prereg section 10. G1 code identity (V1) FAIL -> status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE. G2 controls (V2) FAIL -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. G3 live seed liveness (V3) or census gate (V4) FAIL -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, decision NO_DATA, no revalidation GET spent; this is representation/substrate loss, never a negative. G4 fewer than one completed revalidation cycle (V8) -> outcome=INCONCLUSIVE with the exact budget cause (the treatment object exists but was never measured); decide() returns NO_DATA and cannot yield FALSIFIES. G5 budget (V5), envelope (V8) or denominator (V6) FAIL -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. G6 otherwise apply decide(rows, M-COLD-BATCH-GETS, n_admitted) with the frozen 10% material margin: A_w = pays(cold/n_admitted, mean_path, min_abs=0); B_w = pays(cold, |union|); SUPPORTS iff A_w and B_w at every measured cycle; FALSIFIES iff neither A_w nor B_w at any measured cycle; MIXED otherwise (given |union| <= n_admitted * mean_path, a per-item pay implies an aggregate pay, so the only reachable MIXED sub-state is aggregate-pays / per-item-does-not). The same partition is reported for the no-sharing accounting as S-NOSHARE. Always reported separately: the descriptive B-COLD-BFS-PER-ITEM ordinal statistics, B-COLD-PARENT-START, M-STORE-SHARING-FACTOR, M-REUSE-ITEMS-PER-PAGE, M-BREAK-EVEN-CYCLES, M-BREAK-EVEN-DENSITY, the per-site table (per_host admitted/discovered/GETs/deep-density/sharing), M-ENDPOINT-GETS with M-INTERIOR-ONLY-FAILS, the invalidation counts and rates, M-STORE-PAGE-SECONDS, M-HAZARD-RATE-UB95, M-PAGE-INVALID-UB95, M-FALSE-ACCEPT-UB95, the M-TAU-LADDER, M-LIVE-POS-CHANGE and M-LIVE-NULL-CHANGED. Guard and fallback outputs are reported, not used to overwrite the primary label; the DIRECTOR may use them to bound the product action.
product_consequence_positive: SUPPORTS -> build the persisted deep-path store with a measured maintenance policy: the aggregate economics say a store beats re-deriving by the measured factor (M-BREAK-EVEN-CYCLES cycles to amortize, M-STORE-SHARING-FACTOR cross-item reuse), and the revalidation policy (which pages to check, how often) is set by M-TAU-LADDER rather than by assumption. MIXED with the hazard bound certifying the largest ladder entry -> build the store and use NAIVE replay inside a session (0 revalidation GETs) with an explicit staleness budget, adding revalidation only where M-INTERIOR-ONLY-FAILS or the hazard bound says it is required. MIXED with the hazard bound too coarse to certify any tolerance -> build the store, and treat session-scale staleness as UNKNOWN (the architecture's preferred answer) rather than assuming safety. FALSIFIES -> do not build a persisted full-path store; cold re-derivation or a targeted parent-start fetch is at least as cheap, and the fallback endpoint-only/naive mechanisms remain the product answer. No claim promotion is made by this lane under any branch; C-CROSSSITE stays at its prior effective status.
product_consequence_negative: MIXED -> do not build a general per-item persistence store on this substrate class: a single isolated inherited path does not pay its revalidation cost against the fully-loaded amortized cold share; build the store only for multi-item workloads whose measured reuse density exceeds the reported break-even, and prefer endpoint-level liveness (1 GET/item/cycle) when M-INTERIOR-ONLY-FAILS is zero, because it detects everything full-path detection catches at n_admitted rather than |union| GETs. FALSIFIES -> cold re-derivation (or a different representation) is at least as cheap as full-path persist+revalidate including the fully-loaded per-item cost; do not build the store and PARK the full-path persistence subthread (no discovery rerun, no ladder enlargement). Any INCONCLUSIVE or MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch -> build nothing, record the exact unblocking action (which gate fired and what would change it), and treat a second invalid or null result as the mandate's parking trigger. No claim promotion is made by this lane under any branch.
estimated_cost: stdlib-only (urllib, hashlib, html.parser, http.server, math, json); zero pip installs, zero model calls, zero browser, zero Docker, zero credentials, single runner vantage. Expected GET volume: census <= 4 x 250 = 1000 (frozen-frame reference 926 discovered) plus at most 3 revalidation cycles of |union| distinct pages plus 6 control probes per observation; the endpoint-only arm costs ZERO additional GETs because it is read from the same cycle rows. Hard ceiling TOTAL_GET_CEILING = 3200 GETs. Expected wall clock at the DESIGN-measured 0.02-0.36 s per GET: census ~90-200 s, each cycle ~70-140 s, three 60 s inter-cycle sleeps; hard module budget 620 s inside the harness's 1200 s process envelope. Zero marginal money; the only cost is runner minutes in a single attempt.
expected_information_gain: High for a single bounded attempt, because it settles three product decisions that are currently assumptions rather than measurements. (1) Store build: whether a persisted deep-path store beats the strongest fair alternative (a cold host sweep), and if it wins only in aggregate, the measured cross-item sharing factor and reuse density that set the minimum workload at which it pays - a number the parent's mis-specified accounting could not produce. (2) Revalidation need: the session-scale invalidation hazard of stored documentation pages as a censoring-aware upper bound plus the tolerance ladder tau(TOL), which is what tells Product whether an agent needs any freshness guard inside a session or can serve inherited answers with a declared staleness budget. (3) Fallback sufficiency: whether endpoint-only liveness (the mandate's named fallback) leaves any interior invalidation undetected. A clean MIXED with a certified hazard bound is as decision-changing as a SUPPORTS: it bounds the mechanism to multi-item workloads and makes the no-revalidation policy explicit. A MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch would still be informative only if a new gate fires, which is why every gate is cheap, ordered before the ladder, and reported with its exact cause.

legacy_disposition.classification: LEGACY: DISTINCT_EXTENSION (with one rigorous replication component)
legacy_disposition.comparison: Pre-2.0 next-state work (WP-002B sha 9bb76113aeaf46d9aecdd8a38349a3a7741e57c3 blob; WP-003 sha 292e3243d9bc7a3b88712788a7cb05709eb74eb9 MEASUREMENT_INVALID for prev_action leakage; WP-003B sha f6cfdfc749cae9eb4d9fcc4b11b94b63a2bcfb6e) tested ONE-STEP prediction on trajectories, never persistence maintenance, revalidation cost, or invalidation economics, so there is no duplicate to inherit or repeat. P2-REPLAY-COST (artifact 4.114, sha 9687ff787f2d74460bb7006826008852f5b4416b) withdrew an 8.5x replay speed claim at 1.002x on matched tasks; its binding guard - fully-loaded counterfactual costs, exact-path replay treated as a baseline and never as a win - is adopted and is why B-COLD-BATCH-CRAWL is measured live and B-NAIVE-EXACT-PATH-REPLAY is instrumented rather than dismissed. P2-BLIND-COMPOSITION (artifact 4.697, sha 017a80aeb9a6759c8f6913a37031ff1616ec1bda) restricted inference with weak baselines; the guard - no oracle/keyword assistance and strong comparators - is satisfied here by a fully mechanical crawl policy with no stopping oracle and a measured strongest fair baseline.
legacy_disposition.replication_component: The BFS reconstruction policy, the four min-hop seeds, the 10% material-margin pay rule and the per-item/batch comparison forms are replicated verbatim from the immediate parent packets (EXP-FRONTIER-38184956362 and EXP-FRONTIER-38188815194) so that a live result is comparable to the frozen 926/208 frame. The replication is of the POLICY, not of the defect: three parent defects are repaired rather than repeated (see repair_of_parent_defects).

established_preserved: The frozen instrument is sound: code identity and all nine offline controls of the parent passed under the parent scoring code, so its failure was not instrumental.

Frame arithmetic of the frozen structural frame is reproduced: 250+250+176+250 = 926 discovered URLs on the four hosts, 208 admitted live deep items (hops 3-4), per-item BFS ordinal mean 166.0144, min 31, max 250.

The parent's aged-frame fact: 29/208 admitted items were not reconstructible live under the frozen policy (docs.pytest.org 26, doc.rust-lang.org 3), a pre-registered V3 representation-loss trigger, so its thresholds no longer denote a live population.

The harness-envelope mismatch is an infrastructure fact, not falsification: the parent's 3000 s in-process ladder (>=3558 s minimum wall clock) exceeds SPIDER_MODEL_MAX_RUNTIME_SECONDS = 1200 s with group kill plus git reset/clean on retry.
rejected_preserved: Nothing in the parent is scientifically rejected; it is MEASUREMENT_INVALID / NOT_APPLICABLE with all outcome metrics null. This packet therefore claims no direction about persistence economics from it.
unknown_addressed: Whether the population can be registered live at all and still yield a non-degenerate deep stratum - addressed by making the live crawl itself the registrar (definitional coverage) plus MIN_ADMITTED.
The real store maintenance cost - addressed by M-REVAL-UNIQUE-GETS measured as the physical dedup spend and M-REVAL-NOSHARE-GETS as the named pessimistic sensitivity.
Session-scale change/dead/false-accept rates - addressed by M-CHANGE-RATE, M-DEAD-RATE, M-FALSE-ACCEPT-NAIVE with censoring-aware bounds M-HAZARD-RATE-UB95, M-FALSE-ACCEPT-UB95 and M-TAU-LADDER.
Whether endpoint-only liveness suffices - addressed by M-INTERIOR-ONLY-FAILS.
Whether the harness envelope can accommodate the measurement at all - addressed by V8, the census deadline, the ledger-bounded cycle admission and the 620 s module budget.
do_not_assume_preserved: Do not treat the parent's outcome metrics as zeros, negatives or priors; they are null/absent.
Do not re-run the parent's frozen packet: its V3 gate is deterministic on an aged frame and its ladder is structurally unreachable in the current envelope.

Do not read this packet as validating C-CROSSSITE transfer: it measures maintenance economics on four documentation sites and reports cross-site VARIANCE, not transfer of a learned mechanism without site-identity leakage.
Do not generalize any hazard statement beyond the measured session horizon; the legacy program established day-scale staleness is undecidable on committed corpora.
Do not treat the parent's producer hypothesis (live-site restructuring caused the 29 misses) as an observation.

repair_of_parent_defects.defect: Aged external frame as denominator (parent V3 demanded every item of a frozen items.jsonl be reconstructed live; 29/208 were not, so the packet was deterministically MEASUREMENT_INVALID).
repair_of_parent_defects.repair: The population is registered BY the census crawl that also supplies the cold baseline, so coverage is definitional (n_paths == n_admitted) and can never produce a miss. The parent's list survives only as the covariate M-CENSUS-OVERLAP-PARENT208, and its thresholds 833.4 / 4.006731 are replaced by the same frozen margin rule applied to live-measured cold cost and live-registered population, exactly as the mandate authorizes ('register a fresh admitted set').

repair_of_parent_defects.defect: Structural unreachability of the confirmatory measurement (frozen ladder sleeps 3000 s and spends >5500 GETs inside a 1200 s process envelope that also resets and cleans the worktree on retry).
repair_of_parent_defects.repair: The ladder is now 3 opportunistic cycles with 60 s inter-cycle sleeps, one GET per distinct stored page per cycle, the endpoint-only arm read at zero extra cost, a per-host 100 s census deadline, a 3200 GET ledger ceiling, and a 620 s module budget with latency-based cycle admission. At DESIGN-measured latency the guaranteed minimum (census + one cycle) is ~300 s, leaving the producing agent ~600 s to write the packet.

repair_of_parent_defects.defect: Cost-accounting inconsistency that straddled the decision threshold. The parent's frozen module refetched each item's FULL PATH (spending sum|path| ~931 GETs) while REPORTING reval_unique_gets = |union of paths| (~201 on the surviving subset, i.e. 4.6x lower), and then compared that reported number against the 833.4 threshold; its disclosed a-priori expectation of 'reval_unique_gets ~931 > 833.4 -> FALSIFIES' therefore contradicts its own metric definition and its own code, which would have returned SUPPORTS.
repair_of_parent_defects.repair: One accounting is physical: the fixed module fetches each distinct stored page once per cycle, so M-REVAL-UNIQUE-GETS is both the reported store cost and the measured spend, certified by the new offline control C-STORE-DEDUP-ACCOUNTING; the no-sharing accounting is retained as an explicit named sensitivity (B-STORE-NO-SHARING / S-NOSHARE) so the 4.6x gap is a reported covariate rather than an unresolved ambiguity. V12 makes any future mismatch a gate failure.

design_probes_observed.note: Cheap, non-outcome-bearing DESIGN probes. No outcome-bearing measurement of the treatment was run: no frame page was crawled, no store was built, no revalidation was executed, and no decision-relevant quantity of the live experiment was observed. The only network probes were 4 seed liveness GETs and 8 control-candidate GETs, recorded here in full.
design_probes_observed.offline_controls_probe: python3 <frozen module> --stage controls -> {"stage": "controls", "all_pass": true, "n": 15, "failed": []} (in-process fixture only, no external network).
design_probes_observed.end_to_end_treatment_liveness_probe: A temporary, non-frozen copy of the same module with its SEEDS/BUDGET/MIN_* constants redirected at a locally generated 297-URL synthetic site executed the complete live path: census 297 GETs, 96 admitted, 96/96 definitional coverage, 201 union pages, sharing factor 1.910, 3 cycles, decision MIXED, M-TOTAL-GETS 936, envelope gate PASS. The failure paths were also exercised: census-gate FAIL aborted before any revalidation GET; MODULE_WALL_BUDGET_S exhaustion produced 0 cycles and decision NO_DATA; a forced control FAIL returned rc=1 and wrote no census.
design_probes_observed.geometry_probe_on_prior_raw_evidence: From the parent's own raw evidence research/experiments/EXP-FRONTIER-38188815194/run/raw/paths.jsonl (179 recovered chains): sum of path lengths 788, DISTINCT union pages 201, interior (non-endpoint) distinct pages 25, mean path 4.4022.
